service.description: The plans of the user's maintenance scope (MAINTENANCE_VIEW; PERMISSION_DENIED without), found in the query before paging: text (id or name), organization (ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside the scope), equipment, facility (with those inside it), equipment model, state (open: draft and active, the default; draft; active; ended; all) and the trigger, procedure or team of the terms in effect. Each row carries its target, organization, model default, procedure, team, trigger and interval, its next due (a date in the target's zone, or a meter threshold), the age of its last reading, its due state and its state. A holder of MAINTENANCE_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS with an active organization lists that organization's plans (F83).

One plan the user reads (MAINTENANCE_VIEW in its organization): its row (target, organization, model default, procedure, team, interval, next due, states, the target's time zone, when it was activated or ended and why), its terms in effect as of asOfDate (now when empty) with the origin of each value that can come from the model default (plan or model default), the terms as stored (empty where the default applies), the history of its terms, its due (get#MaintenanceDue's answer), what keeps a draft from activation (findings, each a reason code and its text) and what the user may do (edit, activate, end).

A preventive maintenance plan (MAINTENANCE_PLAN or MAINTENANCE_SUPERVISE in the target's organization; PERMISSION_DENIED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). With no maintenanceScheduleId a new draft for one piece of equipment (assetId) or one facility (facilityId; TARGET_REQUIRED, TARGET_INVALID for both), optionally following a maintenance default of the equipment's model (productMaintenanceId; VALUE_INVALID), under an operation key (a retry answers the first plan, repeated; changed input is OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT). With maintenanceScheduleId, at its revision (expectedRevision; RECORD_CHANGED; PLAN_ENDED for an ended plan): with action activate, a draft becomes active, refused with the code of its first finding (ZONE_REQUIRED: no time zone in the target's facility or above it; PROCEDURE_NOT_QUALIFIED: the procedure the plan or its model default names is not an approved procedure in effect of the organization that applies to the target; INTERVAL_REQUIRED, FIRST_DUE_REQUIRED for a calendar; METER_REQUIRED, METER_NOT_COUNTING, BASELINE_REQUIRED for a meter). A procedure is optional (the user's call, Nov 12): with none, P14 makes an ad hoc work order with the plan's name and estimate (estimatedWorkTime). With action end, the plan and its terms end now, with changeReason (REASON_REQUIRED); with no action, its name and terms change (a call naming no term field changes the name alone): a draft's terms in place (the user's call, Nov 12), an active plan's from effectiveDate (now when empty, after the terms in effect began and after any term already planned, never in the past; DATE_INVALID) with changeReason (REASON_REQUIRED), the terms in effect ended then and kept, as the work done under them is. A plan whose target has moved to another organization is not changed or activated (TARGET_MOVED), only ended. A term field left empty takes the model default's value. firstDueLocal is the first obligation's local date and time in the target's zone (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm, no zone or offset; DATE_INVALID). A procedure named is a maintenance procedure of the organization (VALUE_INVALID). A meter is one of the equipment's model (METER_INVALID; a facility's plan is by the calendar).

parameter.name: action
parameter.description: activate or end; empty to change the name and terms

parameter.name: triggerEnumId
parameter.description: MaintenanceScheduleTrigger: MstCalendar or MstMeter (the model default's when empty)

parameter.name: intervalUomId
parameter.description: TF_day, TF_wk, TF_mon or TF_yr for a calendar

parameter.name: estimatedWorkTime
parameter.description: The hours the work takes, for an ad hoc work order of a plan with no procedure (P14)

service.description: The due of one plan the user reads (MAINTENANCE_VIEW in its organization) as of asOfDate (now when empty), changing nothing: its state (due, overdue, upcoming, or unknown with reasonCode: ZONE_REQUIRED, INTERVAL_REQUIRED, FIRST_DUE_REQUIRED, METER_REQUIRED, BASELINE_REQUIRED, READING_STALE), the lines that explain it, and for a calendar the due date (the obligation, in the target's zone), the planned date (the next business day when the terms ask for business days; the due date kept), the day work is made from (the lead days), the number of due dates passed without a completion and the last completion; for a meter the meter, the baseline (the reading of the last counted completion, else the plan's), the last accepted reading and its age, the usage since the baseline across a reset, the increment, what remains and the next threshold. A planned or cancelled maintenance and a reading made from a planned interval advance nothing; a reading older than the plan's maximum age (30 days unless set) answers unknown, never not due.

The due of the active plans of the user's maintenance scope (MAINTENANCE_VIEW), of an organization, a piece of equipment or a facility (with those inside it), as of asOfDate (now when empty) through thruDate (a calendar due after it is left out; a meter's is listed), of a state (due, overdue, upcoming, unknown, or attention: due, overdue and unknown), overdue first, paged; each a plan's row with its due (get#MaintenanceDue's). A plan whose due cannot be read is named in failures and the others are listed.

parameter.name: dueListCapped
parameter.description: True when more active plans than the 500 read are in scope (impl-maintenance F192)

service.description: The obligations of one plan the user reads (MAINTENANCE_VIEW in its organization) that were acted on, latest first and paged: each its due (the local date and time in the target's zone, or a meter's threshold), its state (open, work made, completed, skipped, coalesced; a catch-up named), its work order and that work's status, when it was satisfied and whether on time, the catch-up it was coalesced into, who generated it (a planner, or the job) and the decision's reason and who. With them the plan's missed due dates not yet acted on (missedList), the work orders made for the plan (workList, at most 200, a corrected one marked not counted) and whether the user may reconcile.

A planner's generation of preventive work (MAINTENANCE_PLAN or MAINTENANCE_SUPERVISE): the plans named (maintenanceScheduleIds, or one maintenanceScheduleId; each in the user's scope, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE named for one that is not), else the active plans of the scope, an organization, a piece of equipment or a facility (with those inside it), at most 500 (capped). Each plan in a transaction of its own with the plan locked, so the job and a planner of the same plan take turns and make one obligation and one work order (the obligation's key is unique): its outcome generated (the work order made for its next uncovered obligation once due: a calendar plan from its lead days before the planned day, a meter plan at its threshold), open (WORK_OPEN: its work is still open; at most one unresolved execution a plan), notDue (NOT_DUE), blocked (PLAN_NOT_ACTIVE, TARGET_MOVED, READING_STALE or BASELINE_REQUIRED: request a reading, ZONE_REQUIRED, PROCEDURE_NOT_QUALIFIED: a retired or unapproved procedure blocks new work) or failed (its reason; the others go on). The work is the plan's procedure (the checked instantiation) or ad hoc with the plan's name and estimate, of the plan's type and team, preventive, from the schedule, waiting for a supervisor's approval unless within the threshold; the plan is set on it by this path alone. With preview, each plan's outcome and nothing changed (ready: work would be made). An operation key answers a retry with its first result. The organization's planners are told on MaintenanceDue.

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: Each {maintenanceScheduleId, scheduleName, outcome, code, message, workEffortId, maintenanceOccurrenceId, obligationText, repeated}

service.description: The generate_MaintenanceWorkOrders job (seeded paused; its schedule, pause and batch size are Admin's, its run outside the schedule Admin's recovery): the generation of generate#MaintenanceWorkOrders for every active plan of every organization, as a planner who is no supervisor, in batches of batchSize plans by id (100 unless set, at most 1000), at most 5000 a run (capped), each plan in a transaction of its own; a failing plan is logged by its id and the rest go on, and a repeat is safe (the obligation's key). Granted to no group. The job's scope is the job's alone: with no user (the scheduler, which also starts Admin's run outside the schedule) or for a system administrator; a person who runs it otherwise generates as themselves, a planner or supervisor of their own organizations' plans (PERMISSION_DENIED without MAINTENANCE_PLAN or MAINTENANCE_SUPERVISE; impl-maintenance P14 review R1).

A planner's decision on a plan's obligations (MAINTENANCE_PLAN or MAINTENANCE_SUPERVISE in its organization), with changeReason (REASON_REQUIRED), keeping what was there: coalesce (the missed due dates named in obligationKeys, all of them when none; two or more, VALUE_INVALID) into one catch-up, the latest of them or the one whose work is open (its work made from now when none; another obligation's open work is WORK_OPEN), each other one coalesced into it, so its completion counts for every one of them (late) and its cancellation opens them all again; skip a due date (the next one, or those named; WORK_OPEN while its work is open); or correct a counted completion (maintenanceOccurrenceId, completed; STATUS_INVALID otherwise): the obligation is open again and its work order is kept and named not counted, and the plan's open work, made from the earlier projection, is named for review (reviewWorkEffortIds). A meter plan's obligation is not coalesced or skipped (VALUE_INVALID): it advances only after a completion with its reading.

The preventive generation job's state for Maintenance's Settings (MAINTENANCE_SETTINGS_EDIT, MAINTENANCE_PLAN or MAINTENANCE_SUPERVISE): paused or its schedule, and its last run. Its schedule, pause and batch size are changed in Admin's Jobs (the job's JobRegistration).
